newsitem.title: GERMANY: Eurostats presents pan-European data on CD-ROM.
newsitem.headline: Eurostats presents pan-European data on CD-ROM.

text.p: Eurostat, the European Union's statistics office, on Thursday presented a CD-ROM designed to allow a comprehensive assessment of markets for thousands of different products across the EU.

The data, compiled in cooperation with the EU's national statistics offices, enables market researchers to calculate and compare the size of markets, Eurostat and Germany's Federal Statistics Office told a news conference.

The European Production and Market Statistics (EUROPROMS) available on the CD-ROM combine output and foreign trade data on 4,400 product groups spanning consumer and production goods, food products and mining.
"This is the first really joint product of the European Statistics System," Eurostat Acting Director Daniel Byk told a news conference at Stat Expo, a statistics fair in Frankfurt.
For example, the CD-ROM shows that about two million bicycles were manufactured in Germany in 1995 while 2.2 million were imported, or that one million toothbrushes are produced in Germany per day.

The CD-ROM costs 2,000 ECU ($2,300) and is available at a discount price of 1,500 ECU to public and university libraries. The current version contains data for 1993, 1994, 1995 and the first two quarters of 1996.
Byk also said Eurostat was setting up a network of "Data Shops" throughout Europe aimed to improve citizens' access to European statistics.
Eurostat already has such shops in Paris, Rome, Milan, Brussels, Luxembourg, and New York and plans to open one in Berlin this year.
Anyone can use the shops to find a range of harmonised EU data which is available via fax, e-mail, in print form, on disk or CD-ROM. A simple table of data costs 15 ECU.
--David Crossland, Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525 ($ = 0.868 European Currency Unit ECUs)
